## Summary
What changed and why?

## Related issue
Closes #

## Impact analysis
- [ ] Database changes are absent or include a numbered migration and safe upgrade notes.
- [ ] API contract/client compatibility reviewed.
- [ ] Authorization and user-data isolation reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local database files committed.
- [ ] Mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts considered.
- [ ] README/API docs/diagrams updated where relevant.

## Verification
- [ ] Added or updated regression tests.
- [ ] `mvn -B clean verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant UI flows smoke-tested.
- [ ] Failure and empty states checked.
- [ ] Deployment health and persistent data verified if config changed.

## Evidence and limitations
Include test output or screenshots, and clearly list any checks that could not be performed.
